about: Story 128.2: the graduated 'how to write toke' prompt pack. scripts/build_prompt_pack.py reads this file and writes tier-*.md and MANIFEST.json beside it. Do not edit the tier files by hand: change an input and rebuild.

a.title: minimal card
a.about: The card's opening and its rule sections with the prose cut to the code: fences only where a section has them, the short reference sections whole. No Patterns block, no task hygiene.

b.title: full card
b.about: Syntax card v2 verbatim, including the Patterns block, which must equal the pattern catalogue's card snippet. This is the tier the 128.1 protocol fixes for scoring (training-reset-128.md section 9.1).

c.title: card + curated exemplar programs
c.about: Tier b followed by whole programs taken from the v0.4 corpus, each built, run and lint-checked with the pin.

d.title: card + diagnostics/repair guide
d.about: Tier b followed by how to read a tkc diagnostic and one broken/fixed pair per code the card names.

exemplars.about: Taken from toke-corpus corpus/regen_v04 full_program records (accepted, 129 freeze, outside the 131.22 pre131 tokenizer holdout). Screened by scripts in the 128.2 batch: no legacy spelling, imports only io/str, lint-clean, build and run with the pin. Curated by hand for the canonical forms they show. Their task families must stay out of BENCH-128 S2 (128.1a): see MANIFEST.json bench128_exclude_families.

programs.title: Validate a length: an error union, guard returns, a match with a default
Extract the host from a URL: expression-if bindings
Build an array and render it: an append accumulator and a string builder
Drop command-line flags and print the rest: append, then join inside an interpolation
Upper-case every string: map with a function reference
Count primes with a sieve: lp, reassigned set, a counter
Read an INI section name: guard returns and slicing

repair.sample_about: The case whose real diagnostic is shown. Not E1003: its message still says 'v0.2 syntax ... convert to v0.3' and lists A-Z as allowed (filed as a bug).
